name: Innodisk Corporation
summary: Innodisk Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and sales industrial embedded storage devices in Taiwan, Asia, Japan, Germany, China, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers flash storage products, such as solid state drives (SSDs); SATA Slim, nano SSD, compact flash memory card, SATADOM horizontal and vertical, embedded disk card; SD and MicroSD cards; USB and EDC; and CFexpress. It also provides DRAM modules comprising industrial embedded DRAM memory modules, server workstation memory, wide temperature/ultra-temperature, and special customized solutions.
